source.check: returned unopposed: the Returning Officer's Notice of Result (Ulster Herald, 10 June 1967, p. 12, block images read) prints Traynor, Thomas, Aughabrack, Dunamanagh, as the only candidate for Doorat and enters him in column 6 as elected; the Ulster Herald of 20 May 1967, p. 14 reports only two contests in the district, Newtownstewart and Sion

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 1 June 1967. Two divisions were contested, Newtownstewart and Sion, 'the first in the history of the Council' (Ulster Herald, 20 May 1967, p. 14); the other 26 seats were filled unopposed. Doorat, missing from the paper's list of unopposed members, is recorded from the Returning Officer's Notice of Result (Ulster Herald, 10 June 1967, p. 12). The earlier record counted Doorat as a third contest whose result was not printed; the Returning Officer's notice shows a single candidate for the division, and the nomination report names only two contests. Doorat is missing from that report's list of unopposed members. Returned unopposed.
